# range/multi-target request generated by abtimeline.py --range (planner fields: council/sandbox/PLANNER_FIELDS.md)
meta kind INTERACTION
meta question How many enemies does Bullet Dance (ability 4) really reach at tight, medium and wide spacing, and what happens to each target?
meta purpose turn the RAW/PRACTICAL range or layout comparison in council/evidence/range/haze_12000.txt from MODELLED to MEASURED
meta mechanics distance bands from weapon falloff and item thresholds; ring layouts from item radii
meta expectedstate souls=12000 items=upgrade_active_reload,upgrade_blitz_bullets,upgrade_titan_round,upgrade_chonky,upgrade_close_range,upgrade_high_velocity_mag
meta build haze
meta checkpoint 12000
meta items upgrade_active_reload upgrade_blitz_bullets upgrade_titan_round upgrade_chonky upgrade_close_range upgrade_high_velocity_mag
meta strategy_source council/evidence/range/haze_12000.txt
meta feeds range plan haze
meta selection_kind requested
meta selection_reason compare the candidate with the alternative across data-derived distances, enemy counts and spacings; written before the run
meta alternative_reason arm B = the equal-soul alternative named in the interaction file
meta cond_scope gun-only plus listed abilities per request
meta cond_abilities_used none
meta cond_abilities_excluded all except where stated
meta cond_accuracy 100% on target (stationary)
meta cond_misses none
meta cond_start_stacks 0 (verify with statecheck before every block)
meta cond_activations range items at distances inside their threshold
meta cond_distance 350u
meta cond_targets enemies=1,3,5 ring rho=0.4r,0.9r,1.3r,2.0r of 16m
meta readbacks equipped_items,ability_tiers,distance_m,enemy_positions,targets_hit,start_state
meta ranges 350u
meta layout enemies=1,3,5 ring rho=0.4r,0.9r,1.3r,2.0r of 16m
meta movement none (stationary)
meta required_start_state stacks=0 buffs=none cooldowns=ready ammo=full hp=full target_hp=keepalive
meta aba A-B-A (baseline repeated after the alternative; invalid if the repeated baseline differs by more than the A/A noise floor)
meta order_alternation second repetition runs B first
meta invalid_if distance_m differs from the intended by >5% | hit count != fired | unexpected modifier present | start_state mismatch | item activation missing inside threshold
meta result_says per distance and per target: damage per bullet hit, whether each range item activated; MEASURED replaces the MODELLED row only if A-B-A agrees
meta player_title Range check: Haze
meta player_what Same item at many distances
meta player_why No assumed fighting range
meta player_short Range sweep
meta player_expect Damage vs distance
meta metrics per_target_damage,targets_hit,secondary_damage,kills,debuff_coverage,healing
meta blocked_by none for stationary rings; moving targets: blocked_by estrafe (no runner op)
